reasoning: BKT entry dead. I bought the idea that three weeks of contracting volume meant supply was exhausting inside the 16.34-17.02 range and the 09/03 up close on 1.13x was demand arriving. Both halves are now contradicted: the 16.910 launch close has been fully given back over three consecutive lower closes (16.87, 16.82, 16.56), and 09/09 printed a 16.235 low on 1,451,246 shares, 1.07x the 1,355,425 average - the lowest low of the entire base, broken on above-average volume. Supply arrived, it just arrived on the other side. A 17.08 buy-stop now sits 3.1% above a market whose coil has broken downward; that is no longer a breakout order, it is a bid on a broken chart.

Cancelling the paired BKT stop with the entry it was written for. With the 17.08 buy-stop gone I will never hold this position, so a 16.30 sell rail is a rail on nothing - and BKT already traded to 16.235 on 09/09, so it is a level the market has been through. Rails that outlive their purpose become decoration; the entry and its stop are one decision and they retire together.
